description: This file declares the WebSocketDeflateStream class, a subclass of WebSocketStream, which implements permessage-deflate WebSocket extension with methods for reading, writing, inflating, deflating, and managing WebSocket frames, including handling compression and decompression states.

classes.name: WebSocketDeflateStream
classes.description: A subclass of WebSocketStream that handles permessage-deflate compression extension, managing frame deflation/inflation, and maintaining compression states.

methods.name: WebSocketDeflateStream
methods.description: Constructor initializing the deflate stream with underlying stream, parameters, and predictor.

methods.name: ReadFrames
methods.description: Reads WebSocket frames, handling decompression if necessary.

methods.name: WriteFrames
methods.description: Writes WebSocket frames, handling compression if necessary.

methods.name: OnReadComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of asynchronous read operations.

methods.name: OnMessageStart
methods.description: Handles the start of a message frame.

methods.name: AppendCompressedFrame
methods.description: Appends a compressed frame to the output.

methods.name: AppendPossiblyCompressedMessage
methods.description: Handles appending messages that may be compressed.

methods.name: InflateAndReadIfNecessary
methods.description: Inflates frames if needed and reads them.
